sources.title: Engineering and Science Admissions Test Content Specification
sources.notes: Authoritative structure and topic taxonomy; 27 questions, 40 minutes, separately timed, no calculator, no negative marking.

sources.title: UAT-UK ESAT overview
sources.notes: Confirms module format, reported 1-9 score scale and separate module results.

sources.title: UAT-UK Test Results and scoring method
sources.notes: Rasch item-response equating; a typical candidate scores around 4.5. No deterministic practice conversion is supported.

sources.title: ESAT Explanation of Results — October 2025 and January 2026
sources.notes: States that a typical candidate scores around 4.5 and approximately 10% score above 7.0.

sources.title: UAT-UK ESAT preparation materials
sources.notes: Identifies historic NSAA and ENGAA papers as ESAT-style practice and marks content that is outside the current specification.

sources.title: Pearson VUE UAT-UK specimen tests
sources.notes: Confirms the computer-based desktop presentation and that official specimen questions include explained answers. Used to review the post-attempt explanation pattern; ESAT Atlas teaching shortcuts remain clearly labelled as original guidance.

sources.title: Cambridge Engineering ESAT requirement
sources.notes: Engineering applicants complete Mathematics 1, Physics and Mathematics 2.

sources.title: Cambridge FOI 2025-1097 - Engineering H100 ESAT averages
sources.sourceQuality: Cambridge FOI request and published response
sources.notes: Cohort means for applicants and offer holders by Home/International domicile. These are not cutoffs and cannot support offer probabilities.
